title.th: คำสั่งตามมาตรา 11(3)

completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 2 条。

text.en:
Revised Edition of the Laws Act
(Chapter 275)
Order under Section 11 (3)
Whereas pursuant to section 10 of the Revised Edition of the Laws Act, the Law Revision Commissioners have published in loose-leaf form the Acts set out in the Schedule as in force on 10th December 2002:
And Whereas it is provided under section 11(3) of the Revised Edition of the Laws Act that the Commissioners shall transmit to the President a copy of each of the loose-leaf edition of these Acts and the President may thereupon, by order published in the Gazette, specify that the loose-leaf edition of these Acts shall, in all courts and for all purposes, be the sole and only proper law of Singapore in respect of those Acts:
Now therefore it is hereby ordered by the President that the loose-leaf edition of these Acts shall, with effect from 31st December 2002, be the sole and only proper law of Singapore in respect of those Acts.

THE SCHEDULE
1. Interpretation Act (Chapter 1)
2. Agency for Science, Technology and Research Act (Chapter 5A)
3. Animals and Birds Act (Chapter 7)
4. Cattle Act (Chapter 34)
5. Civil List and Pension Act (Chapter 44)
6. Contact Lens Practitioners Act (Chapter 53A)
7. Contributory Negligence and Personal Injuries Act (Chapter 54)
8. Control of Vectors and Pesticides Act (Chapter 59)
9. Currency Act (Chapter 69)
10. Environmental Pollution Control Act (Chapter 94A)
11. Environmental Public Health Act (Chapter 95)
12. Financial Advisers Act (Chapter 110)
13. Fisheries Act (Chapter 111)
14. Government Securities Act (Chapter 121A)
15. Insurance Act (Chapter 142)
16. International Arbitration Act (Chapter 143A)
17. International Enterprise Singapore Board Act (Chapter 143B)
18. Land Surveyors Act (Chapter 156)
19. Local Treasury Bills Act (Chapter 167)
20. National University of Singapore Act (Chapter 204)
21. Newspaper and Printing Presses Act (Chapter 206)
22. Sale of Food Act (Chapter 283)
23. Securities and Futures Act (Chapter 289)
24. Standards, Productivity and Innovation Board Act (Chapter 303A)
25. Smoking (Prohibition in Certain Places) Act (Chapter 310)
